name: Sleep
description: Roll 5d8: creatures within 20 feet of a point fall unconscious in ascending order of current hit points, each subtracting its hit points from the total. The sleeper wakes if it takes damage or someone uses an action to shake or slap it awake. Undead and creatures immune to being charmed aren't affected (the charm immunity is not expressible). At Higher Levels: +2d8 per slot level above 1st.

m.text: a pinch of fine sand, rose petals, or a cricket
